Metered.description: What the provider charges for, so Casebench can say what a check will spend.
Metered.title: Metered

description:
How to reach one provider's documents with a built-in connector, or with a connector
plugin named here. `options` are exactly what `corpus add` would write, with `${VAR}`
standing in for the key; `probe` is a search the provider knows finds a document.

key_env.description: The environment variable that holds the user's key.

maintainer.description: Who answers issues about this profile; required for a bundled one.

search_filters.description: What a search for each kind of citation adds, such as a document type, so a statute is searched only among statutes (decision 0037).

keep.description: What the provider's terms let a customer keep on disk; left out, documents are kept, and searches when metered (decision 0041).

extensions.description: Data outside this format, under a domain its author controls, such as {"example.com": {...}}. Never required, and never read by Casebench.

title: Profile
